description: This Java source file is an abstract test class designed to verify the tenant timeout feature in the client factories within the Eclipse Hono framework. It includes test methods that check whether tenant links are closed upon timeout and ensures that links of other tenants remain unaffected.

classes.name: AbstractTenantTimeoutRelatedClientFactoryTest
classes.description: An abstract base test class for verifying tenant timeout behaviors in client factories, parameterized by the client type T. Provides setup, mock, and verification methods for testing link closures upon tenant timeout events.

methods.name: getClientFuture
methods.description: Abstract method to obtain a Future wrapping a client instance of type T, given a connection and tenant ID.

methods.name: testLinksCloseOnTenantTimeout
methods.description: Test method to verify that links are closed when a tenant timeout message is published for the specific tenant.

methods.name: testDontCloseLinksForOtherTenants
methods.description: Test method to verify that links for other tenants are not closed when a tenant timeout message is published for a different tenant.

methods.name: createConnection
methods.description: Helper method to create and configure a mocked HonoConnection with stubs for vertx, createReceiver, and createSender.
